data.name: Nafsah
data.gender_notes: Nafsah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nafsah is an Arabic word that signifies 'soul', 'self', or 'ego'. The name Nafsah carries the meaning “Soul, Self, Ego” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nafsah usually hope their child will grow to embody soul, self, ego and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, Nafsah represents the lower self or ego which needs to be tamed and controlled through obedience to Allah.
data.etymology: Nafsah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soul, Self, Ego.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nafsah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: نفسة
in_arabic.long_meaning: نفسة هي اسم عربي مؤنث يعني النفسية أو الروحية أو الذاتية، ويرتبط بالذات والروح والكيان الداخلي للإنسان. وقد وردت كلمة 'نفس' في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ' (النساء: 29)، وتعبر عن الجانب الروحي والنفسي للإنسان.

in_urdu.name: نفسہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نفسہ ایک اردو نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نفس کی تعریف، روح، یا ذات۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'نفس' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'روح' یا 'ذات'۔ اسلامی روایت میں، 'نفس' ایک اہم تصور ہے جو انسان کی روح اور اس کے اندرونی خود کو بیان کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नफ़सah
in_hindi.long_meaning: नफ़सah एक हिंदी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है आत्मा, روح, या स्वयम्। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'नफ्स' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'आत्मा' या 'روح'। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक और व्यक्तिगत विकास के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: نفسه
in_pashto.long_meaning: نفسه د پښتو ژبی یو نوم دی چې د نفس تعریف، روح، یا ذات معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبی د 'نفس' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د 'روح' یا 'ذات' معنی لري. په اسلامي روایت کې، دا نوم د انسان د روح او د هغه د داخلي ځان څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Nafsah
in_english.long_meaning: Nafsah is an Arabic-originated name that means 'soul', 'spirit', or 'self'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'n-f-s', which appears in the Quran (e.g., 4:29) and signifies the human soul or inner self. In Islamic tradition, the name Nafsah represents spiritual growth, self-awareness, and inner peace. It is a meaningful name that reflects the importance of one's inner world and spiritual journey.

pronunciation.urdu: نفسہ کا تلفظ ناف سہ ہے
pronunciation.pashto: نفسه د تلفظ ناف سہ دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Nafsah carries a profound cultural significance in Islamic tradition. In various Islamic texts, including the Quran and Hadith, the concept of nafs is explored extensively. It is believed that to tame and purify one's nafs is a lifelong journey towards reaching spiritual enlightenment and attaining inner peace. This is why Sufis, or Muslim mystics, have spent centuries studying and practicing the discipline known as "imedia'ah" - the purification of the soul. The name Nafsah, therefore, serves as a constant reminder of the individual's duty to strive for self-improvement and self-mastery.
data.spiritual_significance: From the spiritual perspective, Nafsah represents the intricate connection between the physical body and the soul. Islamic teachings emphasize the importance of maintaining this delicate balance, as the health of one affects the other. The Islamic prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "The body has a right over the soul, and the soul has a right over the body." This understanding of the spiritual nature of the self is deeply rooted in Islamic culture and tradition, making the name Nafsah a profoundly spiritual one. It is believed that by focusing on the purification of the nafs, one can draw closer to Allah (God) and ultimately achieve eternal bliss in the hereafter.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Soul, Self, Ego" symbolizes Nafsah is an Arabic word that signifies 'soul', 'self', or 'ego'.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nafsah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of soul, self, ego.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Nafsah bint Mardan al-Ashja'iya was a poetess and a member of the Ashja' tribe. The name Nafsah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Nafsah was a prominent female poet during the Abbasid Caliphate.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Nafsah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
